title: Tijuana trip with Parker
summary: Parker went to Tijuana and wouldn't come back to work, while Dizzy stayed to handle business.

story.theme_name: Charlie Parker, Dizzy and the bebop revolution
story.community_name: Charlie Parker: encounters, lore and legacy

blocks.x: I remember while Dizzy and Charlie Parker were at Billy Berg's, he wanted to go to Tijuana; he had heard so much about Tijuana, Mexico. So Howard and... I think it was Howard McGhee and Stanley Morgan and Charlie Parker and I, we went to Tijuana. That's where I heard a real great flute player, you know, in Tijuana... But anyway, we were having

such a great time until we couldn't get him to come back to go to work! [HEARTY LAUGH] We said, "You got to be at work tonight." No, he could care less about working. We just had a great time. He came back the next day. They were looking for him everywhere, you know. But that's the way he was. Whatever was happening with him at the time gets top priority, you know.
Dizzy? Well, Dizzy was at work. Well, see, Dizzy took care of the business.

No, he didn't go to Tijuana with us. Dizzy is there taking care of the job, you know. Charlie Parker was very unpredictable during those days; well, most of the time he was unpredictable, you know. Because his values were far different from most people's values. Material things, things like that didn't mean anything to him. It looked like he would try to get rid of money fast as he could, you know. He'd get paid tonight, tomorrow is all gone, you know. That's the way he lived. Somebody would always take care of him, you know! [LAUGHS]
